name: aims-prototype-screen
description: Generates a complete, working PM prototype screen for the AIMS OS Design System repo from a plain-language description — composes it from real DS components following the repo's rules, registers it in the Prototypes gallery, verifies it, and ships it as a branch + PR. Use for any request to prototype, generate, or add a screen/view/dashboard/list/queue/flow to this repo's Prototypes section.
